notes.title: Friendly AI Overhaul
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f2c8112dfb43d6751826db728ff0055abbc29f3a.png

PAMP! Hello there!

- NEW THINGS -

FRIENDLY AI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/28a0545af37ab4bc5966348af2360bb307685878.jpg
 Friendly AI have been completely reworked.
 Bot Friends now have health and need repairing if health runs out.
 Enemies now aim at and follow friendly AI.
 PAMP Guardian can be fixed and recruited. (Rare)
 Friendly AI now follow you to the next floor from the Exit (If they're not broken)
 New textures for Drones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/8b3c56cfea76912fa69ab19f32c1dfe0ac7d1542.jpg


OTHER THINGS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/742b2448991a3f46006eac5efd12f32888570d00.jpg

 Fuel Cell shops.
 Electrical Traps!
 Hub has a few new additions. 
 The Player can now be stunned by electrical explosions (caused by defeating PAMP Guardians, blowing up Fuel Cells or active Traps)
 New PAMP Guardian which fires homing stun bullets. 
 Lots of new rooms and corridors. 
 More uses for the Fuel Cells.
 Ambient sounds slightly louder.
 Health and Ammo shops now more expensive depending on how much you need it. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/679f88fc8924c0273fbfb873b0a92998de42fb99.jpg

notes.title: Another week of updates!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f2c8112dfb43d6751826db728ff0055abbc29f3a.png

PAMP! Hello there! 
There has been lots of new things and fixes this week.

- PAMP RESISTANCE HQ -
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/fa849c10cf49b908088caa3eba9b4189236e0761.jpg
This will be the main base where you'll receive missions and story segments. It's in VERY early stages at the moment. 
The Perk Terminal and Loadout Terminal in the base have replaced the main menu screens. 
Chat to the friendly mission giver (they don't have an awful lot to say right now, but eventually will be more important)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/8b4f4214a0203abd413cb3311539d92f8f6ff6d5.jpg 

- PUZZLES -
These puzzles should pop up quite rarely. They're also in a very early state and will see plenty of improvement in the future. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/190bdad9101f909240a48f4b6d6f02209ba76f84.jpg

- FUEL CELLS -
You'll find these scattered around most levels, pick one up and place it in a generator to refill the power for that floor. (Or make it explode to stun nearby enemies)

- OTHER THINGS -

 - New perks from the vending machines.
 - Enemies can now be stunned. Nice!
 - The Hell Boss should now be fixed and a little less impossible.
 - Time until PAMP Gas is activated has been made longer.
 - Audio bugs should now be fixed.
 - PAMP Guardians now slowly regenerate health. 
 - Wooden crates shouldn't drop 2 of everything anymore. 
 - Enemies all now have slightly longer range.
 - Some enemies try to run away when on low health. 
 - A lot more underground vent sections added to most rooms. 
 - Enemies should not get stuck in vents anymore.

notes.title: TRAINS and more!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f2c8112dfb43d6751826db728ff0055abbc29f3a.png

Hello Pamp Cadets! 
There have been more updates recently! Extra features and bug fixes! Wow!

- NEW FEATURES-
- TRAINS - 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/bc7f2d8fd33b6224531bbb7d8fdd2fc84e9aba51.jpg
These speedy chaps zoom around delivering goods around the base. They crush anything that gets in their way, an excellent opportunity to set a trap or just a nuisance. Remember to look both ways before crossing a train line.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f367f71bf04b553bcef4aaef9890ad663580294c.gif

- NEW GUARDIANS - 
A number of new PAMP Guardians have been added.

- FLAMETHROWERS- 
Some enemies and PAMP Guardians now have Flamethrowers, watch out! 

- TEXTURE FIXES - 
Some rooms had flickery textures, most of these should be fixed now, please report any bugs you find!

notes.title: Another Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f2c8112dfb43d6751826db728ff0055abbc29f3a.png

Hello again PAMP Cadets!

There's been plenty of updates these past few days so I thought I would write all of the changes here for anyone who's interested in what's new! 

- NEW FEATURES -

 - Friendly Robot AI! These guys can be found in need of repair, fix one and they'll follow you and fight nearby enemies. Their armour, weapons and stats are procedurally generated. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/801a2820f2ad978ed039734bb56501a17d742aa5.jpg
 - Brand new UI! All of the UI in the game has been updated and is looking fresh. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/01a78f9195cc4b901dbfe46170932d878da91e39.jpg
 - Ambient sounds. The world now produces more ambient sounds. Spooky!

- OTHER CHANGES -

 - Getting close to the Exit will spawn a PAMP Guardian somewhere on the map.
 - Getting close to the Exit now lowers the music volume until the Exit is activated.
 - Your distance to a PAMP Guardian is now displayed. 
 - You can no longer move after dying.
 - New "Sprint Speed" perk. This makes sprinting faster, similar to the "Move Faster" perk, but only when sprinting.
 - Going into "Focus" now adds a low pass filter on the audio. 
 - Mysterious Eggs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/1ee5533874575d402308734d7b88472008aa3c3b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/860a3ce29e7800cce2e93095faba07b88bbf747f.jpg

notes.title: PAMP QUEST - October Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f2c8112dfb43d6751826db728ff0055abbc29f3a.png

Hello PAMP Cadets! 

Firstly, thank you very much to everyone who is playing PAMP Quest! You're a good bunch.  

Over the last few days since PAMP Quest released into Early Access there have been a number of updates and additions. 

- New Content -

 Around 10 new rooms and corridors added! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/077b62d32caffb0503d0ccac26e103e4665f7f50.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/f4b23c26e5ea9b77b6067db268109a35e2738b3a.jpg
 Traversable Vents, these can be underwater, up high from the top of a room or even underneath a room.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/24b81fe9e7c80e4bbc9b79561bd01fa2561836d2.jpg
 Vsync option added.
 Bloom lens dirt option added.
 "No Ammo" message added.




- Balancing and Fixes -

 Enemies on Easy are easier than before.
 Enemies on Hard are harder than before.
 You can now carry more than one Keycard! 
 If a PAMP Guardian has a laser then it will rotate slower. 
 PAMP Guardian's laser does less damage. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949035/05144db518b1ea7bbc32d27f4f1030c3c83c6aee.jpg
 Shotgun uses more ammo.
